dedupe_keys.name: points de repere du reseau routier departemental de loire atlantique

description: Points de repère du réseau routier départemental de Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Les points de repère (PR) constitue le bornage du référentiel routier départemental de la Loire-Atlantique: numéro du PR longueurs des inter-PR type de PR: début, courant ou fin. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are voirie départementale, implantation, borne. The portal shows 4,522 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
